topography.project_purpose: Farm. Structurally: 93 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 9 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 27 common project-authored base contract(s) (whitelist, oftadapter, oftcore). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
